Acadex is an academic companion designed to help students organize their schedules, manage academic tasks, track grades, and stay focused throughout their academic journey.
A major update introducing new productivity tools, Dark Mode, and improved application features.

• Added Dark Mode support. • Redesigned the Home page. • Added personalized greetings and daily subtitles. • Improved announcement banners. • Added an expanded Today's Schedule banner. • Added Notes, Focus Timer, and GPA Calculator. • Improved campus map information. • Added Campus Map visibility settings. • Added expandable announcements. • Improved data management. • Added semester archiving and restoration. • Added Permissions section to Settings. • Added Scan Schedule QR section to Settings. • Updated Terms and Conditions. • Added Privacy Policy. • Expanded the FAQ.

A major update introducing new features, improved navigation, and a better user experience.

• Added Map and Settings pages. • Added an interactive SVG campus map. • Improved the Map Directory. • Added online announcements. • Added name personalization. • Simplified schedule importing. • Improved UI and animations. • Added Terms and Conditions.

• Added subject information. • Added subject codes. • Added professor names. • Added weekly schedules from Monday to Sunday. • Added class reminders. • Added assignments, projects, quizzes, and examinations. • Added academic activity reminders.
